input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-inducement covenant binds Meridian Fieldworks anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "solicit", "induce", "recruit", "hire", "no-hire", and "employ" surface no restrictive covenant; the only relevant paragraph is § 12.3 (p0049), and the remaining "personnel" references (§§ 3.1, 14.2, 30.1) address Vendor responsibility for its own staff, not any hiring restriction on us. The quote is now expanded to include the operative freedom-to-hire language: § 12.3 expressly preserves our right to hire any person responding to general recruitment (functioning as the general-solicitation carve-out) and records that we have given no no-hire commitment. This satisfies the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so the fallback's duration and carve-out parameters are inapplicable and no redline is warranted.
